description: This walk takes you from the Dartmoor village of Princetown to the nearby Burrator Reservoir. The route runs for a distance of 3.5 miles, starting from the visitor centre and car park. From here you can follow trails south west to Hart Tor before descending to the pretty lake. At the reservoir you can enjoy a nice circular walk or cycle, with fantastic views across the water to the surrounding hills and countryside.
